workflow.title: Workflow Options
workflow.description: Enable at least one analysis subworkflow. The run will fail if none is selected.

cnv.title: Copy number variants (CNV)
cnv.description: Call copy number variants with Spectre (or QDNAseq, see CNV options).

str.title: STR expansions
str.description: Genotype short tandem repeat expansions with Straglr. Requires an hg38 reference.

mod.title: Modified bases
mod.description: Aggregate modified-base calls to bedMethyl with modkit. Requires input BAM with MM/ML tags.

bam.title: Input BAM (single file)
bam.description: BAM or uBAM file for the sample. This pipeline analyzes one BAM per run; merge multi-BAM samples before ingest.

ref.title: Reference FASTA
ref.description: Reference genome FASTA. Annotation and CNV require hg19/hg38; STR requires hg38.

sample_name.title: Sample name
sample_name.description: Sample name to be displayed in workflow outputs.

bed.title: Target regions BED
bed.description: Optional BED file of regions to process for variant calling. A fourth (name) column also produces per-region coverage metrics.

coverage_bed.title: Coverage-metrics BED
coverage_bed.description: Optional BED file of regions for coverage metrics only. Requires a fourth column (region name).

phased.title: Phasing
phased.description: Perform phasing and output haplotagged alignments.

include_all_ctgs.title: Include all contigs
include_all_ctgs.description: Call variants on all sequences in the reference; otherwise small and structural variants are only called on chr{1..22,X,Y,MT}.

annotation.title: SnpEff annotation
annotation.description: Annotate variant calls with SnpEff/ClinVar (hg19/hg38 references only).

igv.title: IGV output
igv.description: Emit configuration for the EPI2ME IGV visualizer.

partner.title: Partner export
partner.description: Prepare outputs for tertiary analysis with a partner platform.

bam_min_coverage.title: Minimum BAM coverage
bam_min_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage required to run analysis.

alignment_report_coverage_threshold.title: Alignment report coverage threshold
alignment_report_coverage_threshold.description: When a target regions BED is provided, BED regions with mean coverage below this threshold are tabulated in the alignment report.

depth_intervals.title: Depth intervals bedGraph
depth_intervals.description: Output a bedGraph file with entries for each genomic interval featuring homogeneous depth.

downsample_coverage.title: Downsample coverage
downsample_coverage.description: Downsample coverage along the genome before analysis.

downsample_coverage_target.title: Downsample target coverage
downsample_coverage_target.description: Average coverage of reads to use for the analyses.

snp_options.title: Small Variant Calling Options
snp_options.description: Only used when the SNP subworkflow is enabled.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Override basecaller configuration
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Basecall model used to select the small-variant calling model. Normally auto-detected from the BAM header; set only when the header lacks (or mixes) basecall-model annotations.

GVCF.title: Output gVCF
GVCF.description: Output a gVCF in addition to the VCF outputs (experimental; SNP subworkflow only).

sv_options.title: Structural Variant Calling Options
sv_options.description: Only used when the SV subworkflow is enabled.

tr_bed.title: Tandem repeat BED
tr_bed.description: BED file of tandem repeat annotations for the reference genome, passed to Sniffles2 (SV subworkflow).

sniffles_args.title: Extra Sniffles2 arguments
sniffles_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to Sniffles2 (SV subworkflow).

cnv_options.title: Copy Number Variant Calling Options
cnv_options.description: Only used when the CNV subworkflow is enabled.

spectre_args.title: Extra Spectre arguments
spectre_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to Spectre (CNV subworkflow without QDNAseq).

use_qdnaseq.title: Use QDNAseq
use_qdnaseq.description: Use QDNAseq instead of Spectre for CNV calling.

qdnaseq_bin_size.title: QDNAseq bin size (kbp)
qdnaseq_bin_size.description: Bin size for QDNAseq in kbp.

str_options.title: STR Genotyping Options
str_options.description: Only used when the STR subworkflow is enabled.

sex.title: Sex
sex.description: Sex passed to Straglr-genotype (also read by Spectre). Inferred from the data when not provided.

mod_options.title: Modified Base Calling Options
mod_options.description: Only used when the modified-bases subworkflow is enabled.

force_strand.title: Strand-aware modification calls
force_strand.description: Require modkit to call strand-aware modifications.

modkit_args.title: Extra modkit arguments
modkit_args.description: Additional command-line options passed to modkit (modified-bases subworkflow).

output_xam_fmt.title: Alignment output format
output_xam_fmt.description: File format of alignment files created by alignment and phasing.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Max threads for more intense processes (limited by executor cpus).

ubam_map_threads.title: uBAM mapping threads
ubam_map_threads.description: Max threads for aligning reads from uBAM (limited by executor cpus).

ubam_sort_threads.title: uBAM sort threads
ubam_sort_threads.description: Max threads for sorting and indexing aligned reads from uBAM.

ubam_bam2fq_threads.title: uBAM bam2fq threads
ubam_bam2fq_threads.description: Max threads for uncompressing uBAM and generating FASTQ for alignment.

modkit_threads.title: modkit threads
modkit_threads.description: Total threads used in modkit modified-base calling.
